topic.title: How Can I Tell Whether My Score Is Good or Bad?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
I've recently built a clean baseline from scratch, but its score seems to have plateaued at a certain level, still falling far short of the scores achieved by existing forks.

This leaves me wondering: how can I tell whether my current score is actually good or bad? More importantly, how do I decide whether it's worth investing more time in improving this approach, or whether I should consider a different direction?

I'd appreciate any advice or insights from people with experience in Kaggle competitions.
